title: SigCompass data compass
description: The Signature Data Compass is a Signature original: a data framework that ingests private documents through SigReaders, organizes them into SigIndexes, and serves grounded answers through SigQuery engines. Its document model, index types, and workflow engine are original Signature designs.

demo.program:
print('compass: readers -> indexes -> query engines')
print('edition: Signature original')
demo.expected_output:
compass: readers -> indexes -> query engines
edition: Signature original
